headline: US Lawmakers Propose Sweeping Ban on DUV Chipmaking Tools to China, Escalating Tech War
summary: A bipartisan US proposal to prohibit the export of DUV lithography and etching tools to leading Chinese firms marks a significant escalation of tech restrictions beyond advanced nodes. This move directly impacts China's ability to produce a wide range of semiconductors, further hindering its manufacturing independence and reshaping global fab and supply chain dynamics.
